title: UniAIDet: A Unified and Universal Benchmark for AI-Generated Image Content Detection and Localization
abstract: arXiv:2510.23023v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the rapid proliferation of image generative models, the authenticity of digital images has become a significant concern. While existing studies have proposed various methods for detecting AI-generated content, current benchmarks are limited in their coverage of diverse generative models and image categories, often overlooking end-to-end image editing and artistic images. To address these limitations, we introduce UniAIDet, a unified and comprehensive benchmark that includes both photographic and artistic images. UniAIDet covers a wide range of generative models, including text-to-image, image-to-image, image inpainting, image editing, and deepfake models. Using UniAIDet, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of various detection methods and answer three key research questions regarding generalization capability and the relation between detection and localization. translated_title: UniAIDet：一个用于AI生成图像内容检测与定位的统一通用基准
translated_abstract: 随着图像生成模型的迅速普及，数字图像的真实性已成为一个重要问题。虽然现有研究已提出了多种检测AI生成内容的方法，但当前的基准在覆盖多样化生成模型和图像类别方面存在局限，往往忽视了端到端的图像编辑和艺术图像。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了UniAIDet，这是一个统一且全面的基准，同时包含摄影图像和艺术图像。UniAIDet涵盖了广泛的生成模型，包括文本到图像、图像到图像、图像修复、图像编辑和深度伪造模型。利用UniAIDet，我们对各种检测方法进行了全面评估，并回答了三个关于泛化能力以及检测与定位之间关系的关键研究问题。我们的基准和分析为未来研究提供了坚实的基础。
tldr: 该论文提出了UniAIDet，一个统一且全面的AI生成图像检测与定位基准，涵盖摄影与艺术图像以及文本生成、图像编辑、深度伪造等多种生成模型，并基于此全面评估了现有检测方法的泛化能力及检测与定位之间的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces UniAIDet, a unified and comprehensive benchmark for AI-generated image detection and localization that covers both photographic and artistic images across diverse generative models (text-to-image, image editing, deepfakes, etc.), enabling thorough evaluation of existing detection methods' generalization and the relationship between detection and localization.
